appliedUpdates.description: Created comprehensive testing guidance for native Vulkan desktop application, including testing methodology, isolation strategy, and assertion-specific testing instructions

summary: All 5 assertions for the rendering-fixes milestone passed successfully. The flow validator tested transparency/opacity (VAL-OPACITY-001, VAL-OPACITY-002), HiDPI scissor coordinates (VAL-POS-002), clipped content rendering (FLOW-002), and font atlas white pixel (VAL-ATLAS-001). Testing methods included visual inspection (25-frame application run with no Vulkan validation errors), unit tests (all 59 tests passed), and code inspection (verified implementation in draw_list.rs, text/mod.rs, render_graph/graph.rs, and ui_renderer.rs). No frictions or blockers encountered.
